postCreateCommand: chmod +x gradlew && echo '🚀 Setting up Java + Android SDK...' && bash -lc 'sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y default-jdk wget unzip || sudo apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk wget unzip && ./gradlew --version && mkdir -p /opt/android/cmdline-tools && cd /opt/android/cmdline-tools && wget -q https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip -O cmdline-tools.zip && unzip -q cmdline-tools.zip && mv cmdline-tools latest && rm cmdline-tools.zip && echo "export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android" >> ~/.bashrc && echo "export PATH=\$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:\$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:\$PATH" >> ~/.bashrc && source ~/.bashrc && yes | sdkmanager --licenses && sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0" && echo "✅ Android SDK setup complete"'
